module.purpose: Provides the canonical mutation API for comment records, applying configured history behavior, stale-record protection, soft deletion, and thread state cleanup.
module.summary: This module centralizes writes to comment, thread, and reaction records. It resolves history policy by mutation category, coordinates nested editor transactions through a writer, prevents stale snapshots from overwriting newer store state, and exposes operations for inserting, removing, editing, resolving, reopening, and soft-deleting comments and threads. Deletion updates records rather than physically removing server-owned data.
module.businessContext: Supports collaborative canvas commenting, including threaded discussions, reactions, moderation, and spatial anchors. Failure can cause lost edits, incorrect undo behavior, stale comment resurrection, or inconsistent open-thread state.
functions: historyModeFor (~L47-59): Resolves the configured history mode for a comment mutation category.
commitCommentMutation (~L75-126): Runs comment writes inside an editor history transaction.
putCommentRecords (~L136-138): Inserts or updates comment records using mutation history policy.
removeCommentRecords (~L150-155): Removes comment-related records by identifier.
readLatest (~L171-178): Reads the current matching record instead of trusting a stale snapshot.
editComment (~L194-200): Replaces a comment body and records its edit timestamp.
resolveThread (~L210-216): Marks a thread resolved with resolver identity and timestamp.
reopenThread (~L225-231): Clears a thread resolution state.
deleteComment (~L252-269): Soft-deletes a comment and closes its open final thread comment.
deleteThread (~L282-295): Soft-deletes a thread and closes it when currently open.
systemCapabilities: Commit comment mutations with undo policy

When kind is 'drag' and options.dragHistory is nullish, the function falls back to options.history.

units.name: removeCommentRecords
units.source:
* This is a hard delete, which is rarely what you want: the built-in UI soft-deletes
 * ({@link deleteComment}, {@link deleteThread}) so the server can prune the records, and a server
 * enforcing per-record permissions vetoes a hard delete outright. Reach for this on a local,
 * unsynced store, or to drop a reaction (see {@link toggleCommentReaction}).
 *
 * @public

detail.name: removeCommentRecords
preconditions: The caller uses this operation only when hard deletion is appropriate, such as for a local unsynced store or removing a reaction.
postconditions: The targeted comment records are hard-deleted from the underlying store on successful completion.
invariants: This operation does not provide the soft-delete semantics associated with deleteComment or deleteThread.
edgeCases: A server enforcing per-record permissions may veto the hard delete.
stateMutations: Underlying comment-record storage is modified by permanently removing targeted records.
detail.summary: Hard-deletes comment records from the underlying store. This operation is intended for local unsynced data or reaction removal rather than normal user-facing comment deletion.

units.name: readLatest

detail.name: readLatest
detail.signature: function readLatest<T extends TLComment | TLCommentThread>(editor: Editor, record: T): T | undefined
preconditions: editor provides access to the current record store.
record is a TLComment or TLCommentThread with an identifiable record ID.
postconditions: Returns the current editor record for the supplied record ID when it exists.
Returns undefined when the supplied record ID is absent from the editor store.
invariants: The returned record reflects the editor's current state rather than relying on the supplied record object's potentially stale fields.
A missing record does not produce a mutation or throw an error.
edgeCases: When the supplied record has been removed from the editor, returns undefined.
When the supplied record exists, returns the latest corresponding record from the editor rather than necessarily returning the same object instance passed as record.

errorPolicy.returnsOnError: Returns undefined when no current record exists for the supplied record ID.

detail.summary: Reads and returns the latest editor record corresponding to the supplied comment or comment thread. If the record no longer exists, it returns undefined so callers can treat the mutation as a no-op.

specTests.then: The current stored record is returned, reflecting the latest values rather than the stale values on record.
The result is undefined and no error is raised.
